title: Euro: Credibility restored supports Dollar – Commerzbank
summary: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen notes that the Fed’s unanimous September rate hike has temporarily restored its credibility and supported the Dollar, prompting a lower EUR/USD year-end forecast to 1.15 from 1.17.

title: Canadian Dollar set for second weekly decline despite pullback in US Dollar
summary: USD/CAD trades little changed on Friday as the US Dollar (USD) pulls back slightly after a strong rally this week. The pause in the Greenback and Treasury yields has offered little relief to the Canadian Dollar (CAD), leaving it on track for a second consecutive weekly decline.
